answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one velvet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The grove report publishes the merge explicitly at each signal. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 57 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 237 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4538 identities would post 4542 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
